title: Quarterly Remittance Return of Final Income Taxes Withheld
manual_entry: Entered Item 23 (12,500,000.00), Part II Items 14-19 Tax Bases via + Add row, and Schedule 1 Row 1 (45,000,000.00 @ 15%) by hand on the real form page

defects.area: Page 1 Part II Items 14-19 (ATC rows) & row drawer
defects.summary: Hand-added Part II rows 14-19 (Tax Bases entered without picking an ATC) drop back to 'No rows yet.' after reloading the saved draft, leaving Items 14-20 at 0.00; the row drawer's ATC picker and Done button extend to x=1325..1384, and Part II still displays '6 rows' next to 'No rows yet.'.

defects.area: Page 2 Part IV Schedule 1 (Columns D, E, F, G)
defects.summary: All Schedule 1 numeric columns print left-aligned flush against the left border (45,000,000.00 in Col E, 15.00 with no '%' in Col F, 6,750,000.00 in Col G) unlike the right-aligned Total below them, and unused rows 2-5 print '-' in Col D and '0.00' in Cols E, F, and G instead of blank.
Official Page 2 carries Schedule 2 (Tax Treaty Code) and Schedule 3 (Nature of Income Payment); the frozen print sheet omits both reference tables, leaving ~70% of Page 2 blank.

defects.area: Page 1 Part II zero combs and Over-remittance (Items 27, 32)
defects.summary: Unused/zero combs (Items 14-20, 25, 28-31) print '0.00' instead of blank, and over-remittance in Items 27 and 32 prints a leading '-' inside the comb instead of parentheses per the caption '(Over-remittance)'.
